label: digit 2 late in a long original sequence, boosted when the sequence starts with o/m/a
explanation: Sparse feature (0.03% of steps). It fires only in the original phase at t>=6 (mostly t=7-8, the last one or two original tokens of L=8-9 sequences) and at the <DEL> step; it never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. About 73% of activation mass is on input token 2 (18.9x lift); every top example is a 2 in the final original positions. Magnitude depends strongly on the first original token: first_tok o (13.5x), m (5.2x), a (2.7x). Most large activations are in sequences beginning with o/m/a. Weaker activations (~12% of mass) land on <DEL> and on other late tokens in such sequences. Most late 2s still do not fire (precision 7% for 2 at t>=6 alone; mass recall 0.72). Adding the o/m/a first-token condition raises precision to ~39% but drops mass recall to ~0.47. The gating condition is clearly incomplete: it is a late-2 detector modulated by sequence-start context.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=o (+6.26), orig0=m (+4.16), orig1=o (+3.99), orig1=m (+3.17), orig0=a (+3.09), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=2 (+2.72). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.15), next_out=- (-4.65), orig7=- (-2.55), orig6=- (-2.54).
